steps.what: Interview patients and clarify comprehensive medical histories in accessible language

tasks.design: Keep history taking and clarification with the clinical neuropsychologist. Existing {DOCS} can provide interview prompts; subsequent report composition is a separate task.
tasks.previous_blocker: A comprehensive account requires responsive questions and attention to uncertainty.
tasks.enabler_now: No reduction in patient interview time is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling incomplete accounts without implying certainty.
tasks.altitude: History taking remains direct clinical work

evidence.claim: Documentation support does not establish a shorter comprehensive patient interview.

assumptions: Interview time includes clarification and contemporaneous capture; report composition is excluded.
The patient and clinician produce the history through this interaction; no ready structured history is assumed.
Existing prompts suffice; no new application.
No incremental upkeep for an unchanged process.
unknowns: Current interview duration and communication adaptations
research_questions: Which history topics require repeated clarification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; direct interviewing retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare verified source material and clinical conclusions for detailed reports
Write clinical report sections with source links and explicit unresolved gaps

loop.purpose: Compose prose expressing the clinician's supplied findings
loop.input: Verified report brief and fixed section template
loop.output: Draft sections linked to source passages
loop.check: Clinician checks attribution, uncertainty, scores, omissions and clinical meaning against the brief
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved content is written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Individual histories and observations need narrative composition beyond field merging

steps.what: Check detailed report meaning and accept the exact final clinical version

tasks.design: Use an approved {DOCS} template and bounded prose drafting from a verified clinician brief. The clinician checks all meaning and accepts the final version; findings and diagnoses are supplied by the clinician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing combines test data, observations and patient accounts with different levels of certainty.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical speech-driven reporting demonstrates adjacent drafting capability, requiring local validation for this use.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping distinctions between self-report, observation and clinical inference.
tasks.human_edge: The clinician owns interpretation and communicates its limits.
tasks.altitude: More attention to accurate clinical communication

evidence.claim: The digest names Medendo, ValueCare and Autoscriber in speech-driven mental-health reporting; this supports adjacent documentation capability, not automatic neuropsychological diagnosis.
Savings for this source-brief report workflow are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Completed assessments and histories are produced by their separate clinical tasks before s1; those tasks retain their own labour.

In s1 the clinician captures and verifies patient identity, encounter date, test name/version, scores, source references, attributed observations, conclusions and limitations. Capture is counted at 30%; missing evidence is sought manually, never invented.
Try authorised native document templates and drafting controls before custom code.
No external dispatch or automated diagnosis; local patient-data access and processing arrangements must be confirmed.
research_questions: Does drafting save total report time after source preparation and clinical review?

incremental.description: Template review and extra quality sampling

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, report text, scores, sources and conclusions; changes require renewed clinical review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88, gross=12%; minus 5 focal upkeep gives net 7%. Range 0-3% allows extensive rewriting and existing efficient templates; E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Conduct neuropsychological evaluations and assess performance in the patient's clinical context

tasks.design: Retain test administration and evaluation with the clinical neuropsychologist. Existing {DOCS} and test tools support the work; report writing is a separate opportunity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test performance needs context-sensitive administration and interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation is assumed for evaluation.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding language, effort and impairment effects on performance.

reach.learn: Evidence limits for different patient groups

evidence.claim: Automated report composition does not establish reduced assessment administration or interpretation time.

assumptions: Evaluation is separate from report composition.
The clinician produces findings through the fully counted evaluation; no free structured validity flags.
Use current test systems; existing runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Which scoring steps, if any, are still duplicated manually?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. No assessment labour is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Diagnose and treat neurological cognitive conditions

steps.what: Diagnose conditions and provide neuropsychological treatment within the clinician's professional scope

tasks.design: Keep diagnosis and treatment with the clinical neuropsychologist in collaboration with the relevant medical team. {DOCS} can provide evidence and guidance without making treatment decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical formulation requires integrating multiple uncertain findings.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported clinical decision replacement is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing causes and choosing interventions that fit patient needs.

reach.learn: How interventions interact with cognitive limitations

evidence.claim: The reporting capabilities in the digest do not demonstrate safe automatic diagnosis or treatment.

assumptions: Only direct clinical formulation and treatment are counted; report writing is separate.
Medical evidence and findings are produced by completed clinical work, with no free risk or diagnosis flags.
Current clinical systems and referral pathways remain.
Unchanged workflow means zero new upkeep.
unknowns: Local scope and clinical team arrangements
research_questions: Which missing evidence most often requires referral before formulation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; all clinical decision and treatment time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical care supported by accurate report drafting
reach: Work with clinical colleagues on clear interpretation
role.ambitious_version: Care remains clinician-led while source-linked drafting helps produce carefully checked reports.
